description: WeatherBot is an intelligent agent designed to fetch and provide weather information for specified cities. It utilizes various tools to gather accurate weather data and deliver it in a user-friendly format, ensuring users receive timely and relevant weather updates.

tools.name: WeatherAPI
tools.description: A RESTful API that provides weather data for various locations worldwide, including current conditions, forecasts, and historical data.

tools.name: SearchTool
tools.description: A tool that enables the agent to perform web searches to gather supplementary information about weather conditions or related topics.

tools.name: WebBrowser
tools.description: A tool that allows the agent to navigate the web to retrieve information from various sources, ensuring the most accurate and up-to-date weather data.
